description: What can be deployed right now: sizes (shared vCPU, dedicated CPU, NVIDIA GPU, bare metal) with vCPU, RAM, disk, included traffic, hourly and monthly price in USD, and the clouds (Hetzner, Vultr, DigitalOcean, Linode and OVHcloud, plus bare metal on Cherry Servers) and city ids each one deploys in. Sorted by hourly price. Filter by city, country or continent, cloud, kind, GPU model and minimum VRAM, minimum vCPU/RAM/disk and maximum hourly price. GPU sizes carry gpu_model, gpu_count and vram_gb fields. Paginated; also returns the OS images.

gpu.description: true = only GPU servers, false = no GPU servers.

gpu_model.description: NVIDIA GPU model, e.g. "L40S", "A16", "RTX 4000 Ada", "H100". Implies GPU servers only.

kind.description: vps = shared vCPU, dedicated = dedicated CPU cores, gpu = NVIDIA GPU, metal = bare metal.

max_hourly_usd.description: Only sizes at or below this price per hour in some city.

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum total GPU memory in GB. Implies GPU servers only.

region.description: City id or name ("fra", "Frankfurt"), country ("Germany", "US") or continent ("Europe").

name: list_options
title: Server sizes, prices and cities
